title: Excavator
prompt: A labelled scale teaching model of the page 23 tracked excavator works in a sand tray. Dig lowers the boom, moves the dipper to draw the bucket through sand, and curls the bucket. Swing rotates the upper assembly on the slew ring toward the spoil pile. Empty tilts the bucket to release the load. Show the third-class boom, first-class dipper and first-class bucket with real ram attachment points, pivots and effort/load arrows. Do not invent a detailed pump or valve circuit for labels.
blurb: A scale teaching excavator uses three ram-driven levers to dig a sand tray, swing and empty its bucket.
adaptation: Scale teaching model with direct pin-ended rams and a sand tray; no detailed hydraulic circuit is represented.
